verdict.rationale: Cal.com's API v2 has a documented create-a-webhook endpoint. Its trigger enum includes BOOKING_CREATED, BOOKING_RESCHEDULED and BOOKING_CANCELLED, and a payload template is sent to a registered subscriberUrl, so it covers created, rescheduled and canceled bookings with programmatic HTTP callbacks. Missing for 10: documentation of delivery semantics (signing/verification, retries, latency guarantees) and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, webhooks notify my systems in real time when bookings are created, rescheduled, or canceled
